verdict.rationale: Firebase's first-party Local Emulator Suite lets apps connect to local emulators of Firestore, Realtime Database, Cloud Storage, Auth, Hosting and Functions for integration testing or QA "without touching production data". It also supports unit tests via the Firebase Test SDK, which directly delivers an isolated sandbox for testing. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, evidence that AI agents (e.g. via the MCP server) can target the emulators, and GA status for the Functions, Pub/Sub and Extensions emulators (still beta).
